item.title: Ukraine peace talks on ‘situational pause’ as Middle East conflict intensifies: Kremlin
item.summary: The Kremlin says Ukraine peace talks are on a "situational pause" as Zelenskyy signals a Ukrainian team could resume negotiations as soon as Saturday.

item.title: Iran arrests 97 people it accuses of being 'soldiers of Israel' in massive crackdown
item.summary: Iran has detained hundreds since the war began, including 97 accused of ties to Israel, following the assassination of intelligence minister Esmaeil Khatib in a targeted Israeli strike.

item.title: Trump rates Macron 'an 8' as France and US split over Middle East strategy
item.summary: Macron calls for Middle East de-escalation while Trump and Israel push military pressure against Iran, exposing growing diplomatic rifts over regional strategy.

item.title: Neither the US nor Israel will 'succeed in replacing the Iranian regime,' retired US general says
item.summary: Retired U.S. Lt. Gen. Mark Schwartz told an Israeli newspaper that he believes "neither Israel nor the U.S. will fully succeed in replacing the Iranian regime."

item.title: 12 Arab and Islamic countries unite to condemn 'heinous' Iranian attacks
item.summary: A coalition of 12 Arab and Islamic countries denounces Iran’s attacks on civilian infrastructure, urges restraint and warns of risks to regional security.

item.title: Iran's supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei 'misfunctioning,' not controlling regime: sources
item.summary: Iran's new Supreme Leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, took power after his father Ali Khamenei was killed in an Israeli strike, but Israeli intelligence says he lacks control over the regime.

item.title: Iran’s hidden mountain nuclear site raises urgent threat, must be ‘neutralized': reports
item.summary: Andrea Stricker warns the U.S. must neutralize Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site and secure uranium stockpiles before ending combat operations.

item.title: Afghanistan accuses Pakistan of killing hundreds in Kabul hospital strike
item.summary: Reported airstrike on Afghanistan hospital allegedly kills 400+ civilians, sparking widespread criticism over muted international response to the attack.

item.title: Belgium deploys military to guard Jewish sites after Iran-linked group claims Europe attacks
item.summary: Belgium deploys military to protect Jewish communities after explosion outside Liège, Belgium, synagogue. Officials call blast a "despicable antisemitic" act.

item.title: Fiery aftermath of Iran missile strike near Tel Aviv caught on video after 2 killed
item.summary: Video footage captured fiery destruction and emergency crews responding after an Iranian missile strike near Tel Aviv, Israel, killed two people.
